messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may harm unborn baby if taken at 20 weeks of pregnancy or later"
set: ["may harm unborn baby if taken at 20 weeks of pregnancy or later", "may harm unborn baby", "not expected to harm unborn baby", "may harm your baby", "may harm breastfeeding baby", "may harm nursing baby", "losing weight during pregnancy could harm the unborn baby even if overweight", "can harm an unborn baby or cause birth defects", "not known whether will harm an unborn baby", "may cause bleeding in mother or unborn baby", "unknown if harmful to unborn baby", "seizure during pregnancy could harm mother and baby", "risk to unborn baby", "could harm the baby", "should not be taken after about 30 weeks of pregnancy", "should not be taken for more than 2 days between 20 and 30 weeks of pregnancy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
